content:
As WhatsApp approaches the official launch of its username feature, the app now allows users to save a contact's username along with their name and phone number. Here are the details.

Some WhatsApp users can see a username field when adding new contacts

While usernames are already a common feature on most messaging platforms, WhatsApp has only recently begun to move away from identifying users solely by phone number.

WhatsApp started rolling out a username reservation mechanism earlier this year, giving users the chance to secure their preferred usernames ahead of the official launch to prevent impersonation scams.

A few weeks later, WhatsApp began enabling the username feature for some iPhone users.

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is now starting to add a field supporting usernames when users add new contacts. The username field appears between the name field and the phone number field.

WABetaInfo noted:

WABetaInfo has observed that both the beta and stable versions of WhatsApp are gradually adding this username field for selected users.

When testing with the latest stable version, although the field was displayed, the system still returned the message "This username is not on WhatsApp" even when a real existing username was entered.

That said, this is undoubtedly another step forward for WhatsApp as it catches up with its competitors, filling in a basic feature that many people feel should have been available long ago but has been missing until now.
